feature.title: 🚀 Feature: Settlement notifications
feature.body:
## Bounded Context
Payments

## User Stories

### Story 1: Merchant is notified when a settlement completes
- As a Merchant, I want an email when a settlement completes so that I do not have to poll the dashboard.

```gherkin
Scenario: Email sent for a completed settlement
  Given a Merchant has a pending settlement
  When the settlement completes
  Then the Merchant receives a settlement email

Scenario: No email for a settlement that fails
  Given a Merchant has a pending settlement
  When the settlement fails
  Then no settlement email is sent and the failure is logged
```

## Trace Plan
1. [ ] ☄️ Skeleton — Merchant is notified when a settlement completes: email for one completed settlement (claims: "Email sent for a completed settlement") #30
2. [ ] ☄️ Deepening — Merchant is notified when a settlement completes: failure path (claims: "No email for a settlement that fails") #31
